## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`@object-ui/fields` 的根入口不再导出 3 个名字:`deriveHexBadgePalette`、`HexBadgePalette`、`UrlCellRenderer`;这是 #25921 的第 16 批。
- 为什么改:两个仓库里包外没有任何代码、文档或技能提到这三个名字;它们的功能另有公开入口(`getBadgeHexAppearance` / `getDotHexAppearance`、`getCellRenderer('url')`)。
- 风险与回滚:代码都留在包内,徽章颜色和 url 单元格渲染不变;颜色计算从 `index.tsx` 原样搬到内部模块 `hexBadgePalette.ts`。外部 npm 宿主若从入口 import 这三个名字会编译失败(未实测,changeset 写了 BREAKING 与替代写法)。`!` patch,回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/fields/src/hexBadgePalette.ts`(搬出的颜色计算,代码逐字未改,只动了注释)、`ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx`(删掉的块、新 import、`UrlCellRenderer` 去掉 `export`)、`.changeset/25921-fields-hex-palette-url-renderer.md`。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`,预期三个名字都 `verified … (export, ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx)`、退出 0。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Batch 16 as named in the seat's amendment 6716064637 on claim 6716009586 (census `/mnt/project-files/pm-orders/ui/25921-b16-census.md`, `origin/main` `604a2b3b`, hotcrm `6961ab1`).

- **`ui/packages/fields/src/hexBadgePalette.ts`** (new, not re-exported by the entry): the pure colour math of the "Explicit-hex badge rendering (objectui#5141)" block moves here verbatim from `index.tsx`: the two contrast floors, `Rgb`, the two surfaces, `clampNum`, `parseHexColor`, `rgbToHsl`, `hslToRgb`, `rgbToHex`, `relativeLuminance`, `contrastRatio`, `readableOnSurface`, `HexBadgePalette` and `deriveHexBadgePalette`. Every helper was read only inside that span. The only text changes are a new module docblock and the `DOT_CONTRAST_FLOOR` comment, which now says `DOT_COLOR_MAP` lives in `index.tsx` (two lines).
- **`ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx`**: the moved span is replaced by a two-line pointer comment; `deriveHexBadgePalette` is imported from `./hexBadgePalette.js` and not re-exported. The block's rationale comment, the Tailwind class strings, `HexColorAppearance`, `getBadgeHexAppearance` and `getDotHexAppearance` stay. `UrlCellRenderer` loses its `export` in place (it reads `EmptyValue`, `coerceToSafeValue`, `isBlankCellText`, `isPlainObjectValue` and `TruncatedText` from the entry's own scope, so moving it would make an import cycle) and stays the standard map's `url` renderer.
- **Tests**: `__tests__/badge-hex-fidelity-5141.test.tsx` imports `deriveHexBadgePalette` from `../hexBadgePalette`; `__tests__/cellRenderers.linkEllipsis-12523.test.tsx` reads the url renderer through `getCellRenderer('url')`, as `cellRenderers.fabricatedValue-8490.test.tsx` already does. No assertion changes.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/25921-fields-hex-palette-url-renderer.md`: `!` patch, BREAKING, FROM/TO for each name, `runtime-export-retired` ×3 (FROM spans 1:1), both declaration lines.

Every other entry name stays exported. `ColorSwatchCellRenderer` stays (README-taught), and so do `LocationCellRenderer` and `AddressCellRenderer` (prose in `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/emptiness.ts` names them; seat ruling in 6716064637).

## Tests

- Census (one `rg -w -F` pass per repo over the 212 entry names): the three have zero hits outside `ui/packages/fields/`, in objectstack and in hotcrm. Positive controls in the same module (`git grep -l -w -F` on `origin/main` outside the package, files): `getBadgeHexAppearance` 14, `getBadgeColorClasses` 13, `EmailCellRenderer` 4, `PhoneCellRenderer` 3. Rule 3: no kept export's emitted declaration names them.
- Reverse probe of the entry (TypeScript checker export list of `src/index.tsx`): 212 names before, 209 after; exactly these three gone, none added. Built `dist/index.js` imported at runtime: none of the three is a key; `getBadgeHexAppearance`, `getDotHexAppearance`, `getCellRenderer` and `EmailCellRenderer` are, and `getBadgeHexAppearance('#1e8449')` still returns the six custom properties. A probe file compiled against the built `dist/index.d.ts` answers TS2305 for `deriveHexBadgePalette` and `HexBadgePalette`, TS2724 for `UrlCellRenderer`, and nothing on the control line.
- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/fields...' build && pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields run type-check` under the lock: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/fields/` under the lock: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 299 passed | 1 skipped (300), Tests 4501 passed | 7 skipped (4508).
- No test added or removed, and no ablation: the diff moves code and stops re-exporting three names; no tested behaviour changes.

## Acceptance notes

- Left on the card: `ColorSwatchCellRenderer` (README-taught), `LocationCellRenderer` and `AddressCellRenderer` (plugin-detail prose). After this batch the `@object-ui/fields` entry holds no further free, untaught, zero-hit name.
